<?php
// E2E probe (test only): stand-ins for WooCommerce Subscriptions and Pre-Orders plus a scenario suite for the void and release guards.
// Gateway HTTP is short-circuited and every request is recorded (secrets are never recorded). Nothing leaves the machine.
if ( isset( $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ) && 'suite' === $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ) {
	if ( ! class_exists( 'WC_Subscriptions' ) ) { class WC_Subscriptions {} }
	if ( ! class_exists( 'WC_Pre_Orders' ) ) { class WC_Pre_Orders {} }
	if ( ! class_exists( 'WC_Pre_Orders_Order' ) ) {
		class WC_Pre_Orders_Order {
			public static function order_contains_pre_order( $order ) { $id = is_object( $order ) ? $order->get_id() : (int) $order; return ! empty( $GLOBALS['cz_e2e']['preorders'][ $id ] ); }
			public static function order_requires_payment_tokenization( $order ) { return self::order_contains_pre_order( $order ); }
		}
	}
}

add_action( 'wp_loaded', function () {
	if ( empty( $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ) || 'suite' !== $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ) { return; }
	header( 'Content-Type: application/json' );
	if ( function_exists( 'wc_load_cart' ) && null === WC()->session ) { wc_load_cart(); }

	$G = array( 'req' => array(), 'subs_of_order' => array(), 'preorders' => array(), 'no_vault' => false, 'void_fail' => false, 'sale_mode' => '', 'n' => 0 );
	$GLOBALS['cz_e2e'] = &$G;

	if ( ! class_exists( 'CZ_E2E_Subscription' ) ) {
		class CZ_E2E_Subscription extends WC_Order {
			public function get_parent() { $pid = (int) $this->get_meta( '_e2e_parent_id' ); return $pid ? wc_get_order( $pid ) : false; }
		}
	}
	$mk_sub = function ( $parent ) use ( &$G ) {
		$s = new CZ_E2E_Subscription();
		$s->set_payment_method( 'cardz3n_gateway' );
		$s->update_meta_data( '_e2e_parent_id', $parent->get_id() );
		$s->save();
		$G['subs_of_order'][ $parent->get_id() ][ $s->get_id() ] = $s->get_id();
		return new CZ_E2E_Subscription( $s->get_id() );
	};
	if ( ! function_exists( 'wcs_order_contains_subscription' ) ) {
		function wcs_order_contains_subscription( $order, $types = null ) { return ! empty( $GLOBALS['cz_e2e']['subs_of_order'][ is_object( $order ) ? $order->get_id() : (int) $order ] ); }
		function wcs_get_subscriptions_for_order( $order, $args = array() ) { $id = is_object( $order ) ? $order->get_id() : (int) $order; $o = array(); foreach ( (array) ( $GLOBALS['cz_e2e']['subs_of_order'][ $id ] ?? array() ) as $sid ) { $o[ $sid ] = new CZ_E2E_Subscription( $sid ); } return $o; }
		function wcs_get_subscriptions_for_renewal_order( $order ) { return array(); }
		function wcs_is_subscription( $x ) { return $x instanceof CZ_E2E_Subscription; }
	}
	// A pre-order waits in a status that is not a paid status (on-hold here).
	add_filter( 'woocommerce_payment_complete_order_status', function ( $status, $order_id ) { return empty( $GLOBALS['cz_e2e']['preorders'][ $order_id ] ) ? $status : 'on-hold'; }, 10, 2 );

	add_filter( 'pre_http_request', function ( $pre, $args, $url ) use ( &$G ) {
		if ( false === strpos( (string) $url, 'transactiongateway' ) ) { return $pre; }
		parse_str( (string) $args['body'], $b );
		$keep = array( 'type', 'amount', 'customer_vault', 'customer_vault_id', 'transactionid' );
		$rec  = array();
		foreach ( $keep as $k ) { if ( isset( $b[ $k ] ) ) { $rec[ $k ] = $b[ $k ]; } }
		$G['req'][] = $rec;
		++$G['n'];
		$type = $b['type'] ?? '';
		if ( 'sale' === $type && 'timeout' === $G['sale_mode'] ) { return new WP_Error( 'http_request_failed', 'cURL error 28: Operation timed out' ); }
		$body = 'response=1&responsetext=SUCCESS&authcode=A1&transactionid=TX-' . $G['n'];
		if ( 'sale' === $type && 'decline' === $G['sale_mode'] ) { $body = 'response=2&responsetext=DECLINE&transactionid=TX-' . $G['n']; }
		if ( 'void' === $type && $G['void_fail'] ) { $body = 'response=3&responsetext=Transaction already settled&transactionid=' . ( $b['transactionid'] ?? '' ); }
		if ( 'sale' === $type && ! empty( $b['payment_token'] ) && ( $b['customer_vault'] ?? '' ) === 'add_customer' && ! $G['no_vault'] ) { $body .= '&customer_vault_id=V-' . $G['n'] . '&cc_number=4xxxxxxxxxxx1111&cc_exp=1230&cc_type=visa'; }
		return array( 'headers' => array(), 'body' => $body, 'response' => array( 'code' => 200, 'message' => 'OK' ), 'cookies' => array(), 'filename' => null );
	}, 10, 3 );

	$gw  = WC()->payment_gateways()->payment_gateways()['cardz3n_gateway'];
	$out = array();
	$run = function ( $label, $fn ) use ( &$G, &$out ) {
		$G['req'] = array();
		try { $res = $fn(); } catch ( Throwable $e ) { $res = array( 'thrown' => $e->getMessage() ); } // code without a guard lets errors escape
		$out[ $label ] = array_merge( array( 'requests' => $G['req'] ), (array) $res );
	};
	$order = function ( $total = '20.00', $preorder = false ) use ( &$G ) {
		$o = wc_create_order();
		$o->set_payment_method( 'cardz3n_gateway' );
		$o->set_currency( 'USD' );
		$o->set_total( $total );
		$o->set_billing_email( 'e2e@example.test' );
		$o->save();
		if ( $preorder ) { $G['preorders'][ $o->get_id() ] = true; }
		return $o;
	};
	$post  = function () { $_POST = array( 'cardz3n_payment_token' => 'tok-e2e', 'cardz3n_token_type' => 'card', 'cardz3n_payment_source' => 'card' ); };
	$notes = function ( $o ) { return array_map( function ( $n ) { return wp_strip_all_tags( $n->content ); }, wc_get_order_notes( array( 'order_id' => $o->get_id() ) ) ); };
	$guard = function ( $o ) { return (string) wc_get_order( $o->get_id() )->get_meta( '_cardz3n_preorder_release_txn' ); };
	$hook  = 'wc_pre_orders_process_pre_order_completion_payment_cardz3n_gateway';
	// What Pre-Orders does at release: restore the full total, then fire the action.
	$release = function ( $o ) use ( $hook ) {
		unset( $GLOBALS['cz_e2e']['preorders'][ $o->get_id() ] );
		$o = wc_get_order( $o->get_id() ); $o->set_total( '20.00' ); $o->save();
		do_action( $hook, wc_get_order( $o->get_id() ) );
		return wc_get_order( $o->get_id() );
	};
	$saved_preorder = function () use ( $order ) { $o = $order( '0.00', true ); $o->update_meta_data( '_cardz3n_customer_vault_id', 'V-SAVED' ); $o->update_meta_data( '_cardz3n_initial_txn_id', 'TX-INIT' ); $o->save(); return $o; };

	// 1) M1: no saved card returned and the void FAILS: order on-hold with a note holding the transaction ID, contact-the-store message, no second sale.
	$run( 'void_fails', function () use ( $gw, $order, $mk_sub, $post, $notes, &$G ) {
		$G['no_vault'] = true; $G['void_fail'] = true;
		$o = $order(); $mk_sub( $o ); $post();
		wc_clear_notices();
		$r = $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
		$first = $G['req']; $G['req'] = array();
		$o2 = wc_get_order( $o->get_id() );
		$res = array( 'result' => $r['result'], 'message' => (string) ( $r['message'] ?? '' ), 'status' => $o2->get_status(), 'paid' => $o2->is_paid(), 'notes' => $notes( $o2 ), 'first_types' => array_column( $first, 'type' ), 'txn' => (string) $o2->get_transaction_id() );
		$post();
		$r2 = $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
		$res['second_result'] = $r2['result'];
		$res['second_requests'] = $G['req'];
		$G['no_vault'] = false; $G['void_fail'] = false;
		return $res;
	} );
	// 2) The void WORKS (unchanged behaviour): "not charged" message, voided note, order not held.
	$run( 'void_ok', function () use ( $gw, $order, $mk_sub, $post, $notes, &$G ) {
		$G['no_vault'] = true;
		$o = $order(); $mk_sub( $o ); $post();
		$r = $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
		$G['no_vault'] = false;
		$o2 = wc_get_order( $o->get_id() );
		return array( 'result' => $r['result'], 'message' => (string) ( $r['message'] ?? '' ), 'status' => $o2->get_status(), 'notes' => $notes( $o2 ) );
	} );
	// 3) M2: the gateway call is a transport error (timeout): the guard stays, a second release sends nothing.
	$run( 'release_timeout', function () use ( $saved_preorder, $release, $guard, $notes, &$G ) {
		$G['sale_mode'] = 'timeout';
		$o = $saved_preorder(); $o2 = $release( $o );
		$first = $G['req']; $G['req'] = array();
		$res = array( 'status' => $o2->get_status(), 'guard' => $guard( $o ), 'notes' => $notes( $o2 ), 'first_types' => array_column( $first, 'type' ) );
		$G['sale_mode'] = '';
		$o3 = $release( $o );
		$res['second_requests'] = $G['req']; $res['second_status'] = $o3->get_status();
		return $res;
	} );
	// 4) M2: a decline clears the guard and a retry charges.
	$run( 'release_decline_retry', function () use ( $saved_preorder, $release, $guard, &$G ) {
		$G['sale_mode'] = 'decline';
		$o = $saved_preorder(); $o2 = $release( $o );
		$res = array( 'status' => $o2->get_status(), 'guard' => $guard( $o ), 'first_types' => array_column( $G['req'], 'type' ) );
		$G['sale_mode'] = ''; $G['req'] = array();
		$o3 = $release( $o );
		$res['retry_types'] = array_column( $G['req'], 'type' ); $res['retry_paid'] = $o3->is_paid(); $res['retry_guard'] = $guard( $o );
		return $res;
	} );
	// 5) M2: an error thrown after a successful charge keeps the guard, does not fail the order, and a second release sends nothing.
	$run( 'release_throw_after_charge', function () use ( $saved_preorder, $release, $guard, $notes, &$G ) {
		$thrower = function ( $id, $note ) { if ( false !== strpos( (string) get_comment( $id )->comment_content, 'approved. Transaction ID' ) ) { throw new Exception( 'boom after charge' ); } };
		add_action( 'woocommerce_order_note_added', $thrower, 10, 2 );
		$o = $saved_preorder();
		try { $o2 = $release( $o ); } finally { remove_action( 'woocommerce_order_note_added', $thrower, 10 ); }
		$first = $G['req']; $G['req'] = array();
		$res = array( 'status' => $o2->get_status(), 'guard' => $guard( $o ), 'notes' => $notes( $o2 ), 'first_types' => array_column( $first, 'type' ) );
		$o3 = $release( $o );
		$res['second_requests'] = $G['req'];
		return $res;
	} );
	// 6) A stale "pending:" guard (older than 15 minutes) is not auto-charged; the merchant gets a note.
	$run( 'release_stale_pending', function () use ( $saved_preorder, $release, $notes ) {
		$o = $saved_preorder(); $o->update_meta_data( '_cardz3n_preorder_release_txn', 'pending:' . ( time() - 3600 ) ); $o->save();
		$o2 = $release( $o );
		return array( 'status' => $o2->get_status(), 'notes' => $notes( $o2 ) );
	} );
	// 7) Normal release: charged once, the guard holds the real transaction ID.
	$run( 'release_normal', function () use ( $saved_preorder, $release, $guard ) {
		$o = $saved_preorder(); $o2 = $release( $o );
		return array( 'status' => $o2->get_status(), 'paid' => $o2->is_paid(), 'guard' => $guard( $o ), 'txn' => (string) $o2->get_transaction_id() );
	} );

	echo wp_json_encode( $out );
	exit;
}, 20 );
